description.text: Program Introduction This Program mainly focuses on the Characteristics and the Nondestructive Detection Techniques of Agricultural Products, Functional Components and Extraction Technology of Agricultural Product, the Bioconversion Technology of Agricultural Product, the Reservation of Agricultural Products and the Processing Machine and controlling of agricultural product. In 2008, the project named as “Development of Non-destructive detection for the quality of agricultural products and the sensor information fusion technology” was honored the second prize of National Tech & Invention Award. A Doctoral dissertation titled as “Apple’s quality inspection technology based on the fusion machine vision, electronic nose and NIR spectroscopy” was ranked among the China’s 100 Excellent Doctoral Dissertations in 2008.

duration.text: The Agricultural Engineering at Jiangsu University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3888 USD/per year ￥ 28000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of postgraduate school 5.Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents.

requirements.text: 1. Aged 18 or above 2. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good health. 3. Hold a Mater's degree.
